notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds (p8); fund balance 2,584,144 -> 2,947,565 (printed; see report_discrepancies for the 1-dollar rounding). 'Property and motor vehicle' 966,411 kept as one line (printed as a combined row; the General Fund combining schedule p22 prints the same amount as 'Property' by sub-fund, used in detail). Ending cash/investments from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p5); beginning cash/investments from its 2021 Restated Totals comparative column (investments = current 150,376 + noncurrent 14,950 certificates of deposit). Business-type lines from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total Proprietary Funds (p11; Internal Service Fund excluded); 'Other' operating revenue is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (p3: 7,207,051 = total operating revenues), so charges for services. Proprietary cash flows from p12-13 Total Proprietary Funds. governmental_net_position from the SoA (p4): beginning printed '(restated 2022)' 13,080,863 with no separate restatement line. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (pp1-2), primary government only. Detail: General Fund combining schedule by sub-fund (p22) is used instead of the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (pp14-15) to avoid double counting; the General sub-fund column includes police (budget p14). Street (p16) and Sales Tax (p17) budget schedules (cash basis; Street property taxes and Sales Tax other expenses have budget only, no actual, so not recorded); nonmajor governmental (p20) and nonmajor proprietary (p21) combining statements per fund. The All Funds budgetary schedule (pp18-19) aggregates all funds without a fund split and would double count, so it is not recorded. Grants with no grantor printed kept as generic state/other aid with review. Capital outlay function only where the fund column names it (General and Airport columns: plain 'Capital Outlay'). Component units (p23) excluded. Read pages 1-23 of 23
